name: Kallummakkaya Nirachathu (Stuffed Mussels)
instructions: 1. Clean the mussels thoroughly, keeping the shells intact but removing the beards and waste.
2. Prepare a dough by mixing coarse rice flour (patta podi) with a ground paste of coconut, shallots, fennel seeds, ginger, garlic, chili powder, turmeric, and salt.
3. Stuff the dough into the cavity of the mussel meat inside the shell.
4. Arrange the stuffed mussels in a steamer and steam until the rice dough is fully cooked and firm.
5. Optionally, heat coconut oil in a pan and lightly shallow fry the steamed mussels to achieve a crisp exterior.
description: Kallummakkaya Nirachathu is a quintessential delicacy from the Malabar region of Kerala, particularly popular among the Mappila community. It represents the rich coastal culinary heritage of Northern Kerala, showcasing the ingenious use of locally available seafood and coconut.
